title: 国際教養理工学特別科目(PD Ⅰnnovation)(夏期集中講義)
subtitle: PD Innovation

educationalGoal: This course will provide learners the basic concept of innovation, and why we need innovation capacity as required in our future society. Students identify and solve problems or challenges in a logical, scientific, and creative way to commercialize a business idea. The course focuses on exploring how feasible the business idea can be.
advice: In the course, students work in groups and individually, developing skills in teamwork to create value of creative ideas. 1. The five disciplines of innovation of Stanford Research Institute (SRI) will be utilized and demonstrated through the lessons. 2. The course uses the SRI's NABC framework (Needs - Approach - Benefits/Costs - Competition) as the backbone of the course in describing and expressing the value proposition of innovative business ideas. 3. The value of the innovation projects will be continuously added through the Value Creation Forum (VCF). 4. The propositions are also expressed through the Project Design Model Canvas (PDMC) to provide customers / stakeholders the best overview of the project.
books: Textbooks or learning materials will be provided in the class.
requiredKnowledge: To be successful in the course, the learners are required: - to be positive and creative in the process of identifying and solving problems. - to be responsible and collaborative in completing all assignments in the team. - to have a positive mindset and a growth mindset in all activities to create new values for themselves and for community.

activityGoals.body: Form the basic concept of a creative project and develop it toward innovations.
Develop each learner's creative thinking based on their existing potentials (learned knowledge and skills).
Develop teamwork capacity to create new values.
Develop other important skills/competencies, such as communication skills (speaking,writing,graphics,listening)

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
